title: A Rudin-Carleson theorem with uniform approximation for manifold-valued maps
summary: Given a closed set $E \subset \partial {\mathbb D}$ of measure zero and a continuous function $\varphi : E \to {\mathbb C}$, the classical Rudin-Carleson interpolation theorem states that there exists a continuous function $F : \overline {\mathbb D} \to {\mathbb C}$ that is holomorphic on ${\mathbb D}$ and satisfies $F\rvert_E = \varphi$.
